sources.entry: SoundCloud for macOS - Unofficial lightweight SoundCloud app for macOS. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/jettsba/SoundCloud-for-macOS) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: An unofficial, lightweight native macOS desktop wrapper around soundcloud.com that adds background playback and system media-key support.
summary.what_it_does: The app wraps soundcloud.com in a native AppKit window using a WKWebView with a persistent cookie store, so sign-in persists between launches. Playback continues when the window is closed, and the app quits only with ⌘Q. Media keys, Control Center and Now Playing widgets control previous, next, play and pause, via an injected script (Player.js) that registers actions with the Media Session API. The app supports sign-in with Google, Apple or Facebook as well as email and password. It pauses when the lid closes and stays paused after wake until the user presses play. Links to other websites open in the default browser.
use_cases: Listen to SoundCloud as a standalone Mac app
Control SoundCloud playback with keyboard media keys
Keep music playing with the window closed
Run SoundCloud without a browser tab
Build the SoundCloud Mac app from source
how_to_run: Download SoundCloud.dmg from the latest release
Open the DMG and drag SoundCloud to Applications
If blocked, allow it under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway, or run: xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/SoundCloud.app
Build from source: git clone the repo, then cd SoundCloud-for-macOS
xcodebuild -project SoundCloud.xcodeproj -scheme SoundCloud -configuration Release -derivedDataPath build build
notable: Background playback continues after the window is closed; the Dock icon reopens it
Media keys and Control Center controls replace default ±15 second buttons
Page is not throttled during playback, avoiding audio dropouts
Pauses on lid close and stays paused after wake
Continues the earlier rlacombe/SoundCloud-macOS project with its history kept
caveats: Not notarized by Apple, so the first launch requires a manual approval or quarantine removal
Media controls depend on SoundCloud's web player markup and may break if SoundCloud changes it
Requires macOS 15.2 or later and Xcode 16 or later to build from source
Unofficial and not affiliated with SoundCloud
keywords: keep music playing with window closed
sign in with google apple facebook
